scope: Ordered cis-anti-I additive CHARMM, isolated NAMD engineering candidate followed by separately scored preliminary interstrand structural qualification
supersedes_for_this_scope: cpd-anti-validation-v1; retain its failed and incomplete verdicts
rationale: User authorized the literature-reviewed staged workflow and campaign resume. Independent charge, conformational-reference, engine and context stages prevent unrelated acquisition from blocking useful work. No full scientific release.

optimizer.method_change: geomeTRIC conmethod 0, enforce 0.1, initial trust 0.002 A, maximum trust 0.02 A
optimizer.qm: MP2/6-31G(d), DF, frozen core, E/D 1e-12, response 1e-10; unchanged
optimizer.claim: Constrained stationarity only; no unconstrained/global minimum certification

electrostatics.dataset: Three existing conformers: endpoint-1 original, endpoint-2 original and remote; all 17 previously clean water curves, all three HF dipoles
electrostatics.excluded: Remote endpoint-2 1:O4 original mixed O5-prime contact; retain diagnostic
electrostatics.target: Uncorrected HF/6-31G(d) water energy x1.16, polar minimum distance -0.2 A; directly target unscaled HF dipole vectors
electrostatics.fixed: Sugar/cap charges, aliphatic H6 and methyl-H charges, LJ and bonded terms
electrostatics.variables: Remaining shared ordered base-atom charge shifts; sum zero; absolute shift <=0.15 e
electrostatics.objective: Equal mean-square energy, distance and dipole blocks plus 0.2-weight charge-shift regularization; energy/0.2 kcal/mol, distance/0.1 A, dipole-vector/0.5 D, shift/0.1 e; ESP reported, not optimized
electrostatics.dipole: Reported residuals and fitted target; no mandatory magnitude ratio
electrostatics.second_round: Requires recorded objective/residual diagnosis; no automatic regularization sweep
electrostatics.exposure: All current data are exposed development/regression; no blind-validation claim

conformational.development_membership: All 15 cases in cpd-anti-remote-profile-mm-v1/plan.json, plus endpoint-2 lower reference, lower -30, lower -15 and unresolved lower +15; preserve branch identities
conformational.stage_lock: Exact case sources and reference identities must be frozen before torsion fitting; stalled/absent case cannot pass or be energy-pruned
conformational.geometry_scope: Registered representative minima, changed lesion and attachment terms; unchanged parent sugar/backbone reported separately
conformational.energy_reference: Same QM-selected conformer identity used for MM and QM relative energies; report branch correspondence and lowest-observed envelopes separately
conformational.torsion_scope: Minimal preregistered changed torsions; phase 0 or 180 degrees; transferable LJ and parent sugar/phosphate retained
conformational.prospective_validation: Four glycosidic offsets: +/-22.5 degrees from original endpoint-1 reference and lower endpoint-2 reference; candidate hash registered before target acquisition; one evaluation of the locked candidate
conformational.unresolved_case_action: Stop torsion fitting, retain incomplete reference stage; independent electrostatics and engineering assembly may continue

engine.prerequisites: Hash-pinned explicit candidate, correct graph/charge/stereo, complete term coverage, stable representative local MM geometries; carry all failed scientific metrics
engine.diagnostic_permission: Isolated assembly and native NAMD smoke may proceed with parameter-quality stages still failed/incomplete; never promotes preliminary research or normal app support

preliminary_context.requires: Electrostatics, conformational validation and engine stages all pass; concrete isolated geometry review before normal app integration
preliminary_context.claim: Bounded exploratory structural support; no equilibrium, mechanics or photochemistry claim

authority: 0.03 A/3 degrees and fitting conventions have primary-literature support; numerical energy, practical water, engine and budget cutoffs are explicit local choices
